heading: 1.01.010 - In-house code.
text:
That in preparation of codifying the existing city code, the city clerk and city attorney
have prepared an in-house general revision to the current code of ordinances for the
city of Cheyenne, Wyoming to assist in providing a modern and systematic re-organization
of material.

(Ord. 3514 § 1, 2003)

heading: 1.01.020 - Code adopted.
text:
That based upon the in-house revision, the code of ordinances of the city of Cheyenne,
Wyoming, as professionally compiled, edited, recodified and published by Book Publishing
Company, Seattle, Washington, now known as LexisNexis Municipal Codes, of Charlottesville,
Virginia, is adopted pursuant to authority granted cities and towns set forth in Wyoming
Statute § 15-1-103 (a) (xxxviii).

(Ord. 3514 § 2, 2003)

heading: 1.01.030 - References to code.
text:
This code shall be known as the code of ordinances of the city of Cheyenne, Wyoming
and may be referred to as the Cheyenne city code in any prosecution for the violation
of any provision thereof or in any proceeding at law or equity. It will be sufficient
to designate any ordinance adding to, amending, correcting or repealing all of any
part or portion thereof as an addition to, amendment to, correction or repeal of the
Cheyenne city code. References may be made to the titles, chapters, sections and subsections
of the Cheyenne city code and references apply to those titles, chapters, sections
or subsections as they appear in the code.

(Ord. 3514 § 3, 2003)
